service the marketplace.   The possibilities to consider would be the items

optimum structure.  This view is based on the fact that we both have
similar assets, resources and market potential that would likely fit
together in a combination of some kind very well.  We see working together

tool to our offering as limiting over the long term.

appropriate aspects of the Special Purpose Vehicle and if appropriate
determine the go forward approach.  It is our view that both parties would

requirements) and overall initial contributions of the parties.  We think
this effort could be completed in 1 or 2 weeks at most.

be calling you later today to set-up the logistics for the discussions next
week.  I will ask our people to come to Houston for these meetings.  In the

Paul

Lippman Consulting, Inc. is pleased to announce that it has just completed 
the 3rd quarterly of 2001 production report for the Gulf Coast Region.  This 
report contains numerous charts and graphs as well as extensive text 
depicting the historical volumes produced from this region through the third 
quarter of 2001.  This report analyzes the production in various ways so that 
the reader can obtain a complete understanding of the supplies contained in 
this dynamic region. This is truly a bottoms up report.  Lippman Consulting 
is currently publishing twelve separate monthly reports covering each of the 
area's specific regions that make up the Gulf Coast.  Extensive detailed data 
is contained in each of those reports. This quarterly report, which compiles 
the data for each of those area reports, is intended to be a summary report 
for our clients that do not want that level of detail but want to be advised 
on the overall Gulf volumes. The Gulf Coast region contains almost 50% of the 
domestic production and therefore is very important to the overall national 
gas markets.

ISO Operating Procedure Updated:  T-116 AC/DC Nomogram with attachment A
			Please Note: Attachment B is NOT Posted for Security
Reasons
Version: 4.1
Effective Date: 8-1-2001
Procedure Purpose: The purpose of the COI/NW-Sierra and PDCI north-to-south
operating Nomogram (AC/DC Nomogram) is to operate in conformance with the
WSCC Minimum Operating Reliability Criteria (MORC) and to protect the WSCC
system during heavy export conditions from the Northwest to the Southwest
from disturbances similar to those that occurred on July 2 and August 10,
1996.  The Nomograms are based on the loss of the Bipolar PDCI, a 2-unit
loss at Palo Verde, a 2-unit loss of Moss Landing, or a Table Mountain South
Double Line Outage.  The Nomograms are limited by post-transient Outages.
Summary of changes: The WSCC stability limit changed from 10 to 20 minutes.

*	Please find them at
http://www1.caiso.com/thegrid/operations/opsdoc/index.html under the
appropriate Operating Procedure section heading.

mailbox [mailto:procctrldesk@caiso.com] and we will respond as soon as
possible.

Thank-You,

Operations Support and Training
